Create an extraordinary full-screen cinematic aerial terrain of memory strata, inspired by the visual scale and depth of the user's Space Voyage, Golden Portal and Agent Wave examples. Create a materially sophisticated darker hero inspired by the user's Fin Coin, Monolithic, Design World and Book Hero examples, adapted to the actual Factmend identity. Full bleed deep olive-black architectural studio, cinematic warm grazing light, precise ivory typography and a rich amber focal layer.
